work_item: B04 ordinary CLI follow-up for grouped CSV statistics
source_snapshot_method: SHA-256 of the compact JSON file inventory in code-snapshot.json

pre_correction_observation.observed_result: All eight small Japanese/English CSV grouped-statistics probes returned SUSPEND with LANGUAGE_RESOURCE_OR_COVERAGE: MODEL_RESOURCE_LIMIT after producing one computed dependency.
pre_correction_observation.cause: The output path scored exact sequence probability for a single candidate containing the joined result units. That candidate had no competing alternative, and the irrelevant exact probability multiplication exceeded the existing 8192-bit operation envelope.
pre_correction_observation.scope: Exploratory probes that exposed the ordinary-route defect; not counted as passing tests.

correction: For a single supported candidate, preserve token-budget checks, model-byte checks, lossless token projection/reconstruction, contexts and model revision while omitting the irrelevant sequence probability. Exact scoring and ranking are unchanged when multiple candidates exist. The 8192-bit operation envelope and the existing token/model/resource limits were not increased.

tests_and_route.route_method: Integration tests launched the built minidora-rust binary with --json and fresh temporary databases, then used a separate inspect process; no action or result was injected.

known_limits: The cases are scoped author-created examples and do not establish an independent held-out acceptance population or complete B04 acceptance.
The positive route uses an explicitly supplied headered CSV with two named columns and exact numeric values; it does not establish broad schema transformation or all table input behavior.
Other B04 slices, including JSON table grouped statistics and broader CSV/JSON transformations, remain outside this follow-up.

acceptance.B04: UNVERIFIED; selected Japanese and English CSV grouped-statistics ordinary-route cases and one typed error route passed, but the complete B04 contract and independent acceptance population remain unverified
